description: Build a refund from the payee back to the payer, linked to the original receipt. The payee signs it and pays its gas; it has no m2m.monster fee and the original fee is not returned. Unsigned. Sign it locally with your own Solana key; m2m.monster never sees or uses agents' private keys.

amount.description: Refund amount, at most the original gross amount

receipt.description: Receipt JWS of the original payment

name: build_refund
